 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Each horizontal segment has one-cell gaps. Close a gap when its two
    # neighbors have the same nonzero color, then extend that color upward.
    sources = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            color = row[c - 1]
            if color != 0 and row[c] == 0 and row[c + 1] == color:
                out[r][c] = color
                sources.append((r, c, color))
    # Rays grow upward, stopping at any already-colored cell, including rays
    # from another band. Process lower sources first so the nearest band wins.
    for r, c, color in sorted(sources, reverse=True):
        rr = r - 1
        while rr >= 0 and out[rr][c] == 0:
            out[rr][c] = color
            rr -= 1
    return out
"

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Complete each broken horizontal bar by projecting its colors to the
    # bottommost row of that same band; gaps seed upward rays of that color.
    rays = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        nz = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if len(nz) < 2:
            continue
        # one-pixel internal holes are part of the bar
        for c in range(nz[0] + 1, nz[-1]):
            if row[c] == 0:
                left = next((row[k] for k in range(c - 1, -1, -1) if row[k]), 0)
                right = next((row[k] for k in range(c + 1, w) if row[k]), 0)
                color = left if left else right
